title: Per Docker one sentiment model and reproducibility
content: Every Docker-Container contains only one model, which are offline saved. Added two sentiment models: twitter-xlm-roberta-base-sentiment, citizenlab-twitter-xlm-roberta-base-sentiment-finetunned
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: Torch Version Update
content: Updated torch version from 2.2.0 to 2.5.1, because of security issues of the torch python library.
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: Five new sentiment models
content: Added 5 new sentiment models: distilbert-base-multilingual-cased-sentiments-student, philschmid-distilbert-base-multilingual-cased-sentiments-student, cardiffnlp-sentiment-en, roberta-based-en, finance-sentiment-de
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: One new sentiment models
content: Added one new sentiment models: german-sentiment-bert
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: Two new topic models
content: Added two topic models: cardiffnlp/tweet-topic-latest-multi, chkla/parlbert-topic-german
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: Removing two Topic models
content: Removed two topic Models because of security issue and access rights of updatet model: KnutJaegersberg/topic-classification-IPTC-subject-labels, poltextlab/xlm-roberta-large-manifesto-cap
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: Eight new emotion models

title: DUUI integration of Multimodal Component
content: DUUI integration of Multimodal Component. Allows to work with different vLLMs, which support multimodal content. One docker-container can work with multiple vLLMs.
author: Ali Abusaleh
